d:
The Trail Blazers defeated the Lakers, 136-129 tonight in Los Angeles. Ja Morant contributed a team-high 23 points to go with 4 assists, with Deni Avdija of the Trail Blazers adding an additional 23 points (8-15 FG, 4-7 3P) and 9 assists in the game. Luka Dončić finished with a team-high 41 points along with 9 assists for the Lakers in the losing effort. The Trail Blazers improve their record to 3-0 with the win, while the Lakers fall to 3-1 for the season.
